title: त्रिनवतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: As Satyaki drives the troops before him, Drona attacks with showers of arrows, and the two fight furiously. Satyaki does a marvellous feat in fighting Drona and checking the Pandava and Panchala troops that Drona opposed.
summary.kn: ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ ದ್ರೋಣ ಬಾಣವರ್ಷದಿಂದ ಎರಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಉಗ್ರವಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ದ್ರೋಣನೊಡನೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಪಾಂಡವ-ಪಾಂಚಾಲರನ್ನು ತಡೆದ ದ್ರೋಣನನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿ ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಸಾಹಸ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: सात्यकि के सेना को भगाने पर द्रोण बाणवर्षा के साथ आक्रमण करते हैं और दोनों उग्र युद्ध करते हैं। द्रोण से लड़ते हुए सात्यकि अद्भुत पराक्रम दिखाता है।
summary.te: సాత్యకి సేనను తరుముతుండగా ద్రోణుడు బాణవర్షంతో దాడి చేస్తాడు; ఇద్దరూ ఉగ్రంగా పోరాడతారు. ద్రోణునితో పోరాడుతూ సాత్యకి అద్భుత పరాక్రమం చూపుతాడు.
summary.ta: சாத்யகி படையை விரட்ட, த்ரோணர் அம்பு மழையுடன் தாக்க, இருவரும் கடுமையாகப் போரிடுகின்றனர். த்ரோணருடன் போரிட்டு சாத்யகி அற்புதமான வீரம் காட்டுகிறான்.
summary.ml: സാത്യകി സേനയെ മുന്നോട്ടു തള്ളുമ്പോൾ ദ്രോണർ അമ്പുമഴയുമായി ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു; ഇരുവരും ഉഗ്രമായി പൊരുതുന്നു. ദ്രോണരെ നേരിട്ട്, അദ്ദേഹം തടഞ്ഞുനിർത്തിയിരുന്ന പാണ്ഡവ, പാഞ്ചാല സേനകളെ മുന്നോട്ടുനയിച്ച് സാത്യകി അത്ഭുതകൃത്യം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.93; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
काल्यमानेषु सैन्येषु शैनेयेन ततस्ततः ।
भारद्वाजः शरव्रातैर्महद्भिः समवाकिरत् ॥

meaning.en: As the armies were driven here and there by Shaineya, Bharadvaja's son covered him with great swarms of arrows.

verses.text:
स संप्रहारस्तुमुलो द्रोणसात्वतयोरभूत् ।
पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां बलिवासवयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous clash then took place between Drona and the Satvata, as all the armies watched, like that of Bali and Vasava.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणः शिनेः पौत्रं चित्रैः सर्वायसैः शरैः ।
त्रिभिराशीविषाकारैर्ललाटे समविध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona struck the grandson of Shini on the forehead with three varied, all-iron arrows shaped like venomous snakes.

verses.text:
तैर्ललाटार्पितैर्बाणैर्युयुधानस्त्वजिह्मगैः ।
व्यरोचत महाराज त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: With those straight arrows planted in his forehead, Yuyudhana, O great king, shone like a three-peaked mountain.

verses.text:
ततोऽस्य बाणानपरानिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनान् ।
भारद्वाजोऽन्तरप्रेक्षी प्रेषयामास संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Then Bharadvaja's son, watching for an opening, sent other arrows at him in the battle, sounding like Indra's thunderbolt.

verses.text:
तान्द्रोणचापनिर्मुक्तान्दाशार्हः पततः शरान् ।
द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां सुपुङ्खाभ्यां चिच्छेद परमास्त्रवित् ॥

meaning.en: The Dasharha, master of the best weapons, cut those arrows, as they flew from Drona's bow, each with two fine-feathered arrows.

verses.text:
तामस्य लघुतां द्रोणः समवेक्ष्य विशां पते ।
प्रहस्य सहसाविध्यद्विंशत्या शिनिपुंगवम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his quickness, O lord of the people, Drona laughed and suddenly pierced the bull of the Shinis with twenty arrows.

verses.text:
पुनः पञ्चाशतेषूणां शतेन च समार्पयत् ।
लघुतां युयुधानस्य लाघवेन विशेषयन् ॥

meaning.en: Again he struck him with fifty and then with a hundred arrows, outdoing Yuyudhana's quickness with his own.

verses.text:
समुत्पतन्ति वल्मीकाद्यथा क्रुद्धा महोरगाः ।
तथा द्रोणरथाद्राजन्नुत्पतन्ति तनुच्छिदः ॥

meaning.en: As enraged great serpents rise from an anthill, so armor-piercing arrows rose from Drona's chariot, O king.

verses.text:
तथैव युयुधानेन सृष्टाः शतसहस्रशः ।
अवाकिरन्द्रोणरथं शरा रुधिरभोजनाः ॥

meaning.en: Likewise the arrows sent by Yuyudhana, hundreds of thousands, which feed on blood, covered Drona's chariot.

verses.text:
लाघवाद्द्विजमुख्यस्य सात्वतस्य च मारिष ।
विशेषं नाध्यगच्छाम समावास्तां नरर्षभौ ॥

meaning.en: In the quickness of the chief of brahmins and of the Satvata, O lord, we could find no difference between those two bulls among men.

verses.text:
सात्यकिस्तु ततो द्रोणं नवभिर्नतपर्वभिः ।
आजघान भृशं क्रुद्धो ध्वजं च निशितैः शरैः ।
सारथिं च शतेनैव भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki, greatly enraged, struck Drona with nine straight-jointed arrows, and his banner with sharp arrows, and his charioteer with a hundred, in sight of Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
लाघवं युयुधानस्य दृष्ट्वा द्रोणो महारथः ।
सप्तत्या सात्यकिं विद्ध्वा तुरगांश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः ।
ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध माधवस्य रथे स्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Yuyudhana's quickness, the great chariot-warrior Drona struck Satyaki with seventy, his horses with three each, and the banner standing on Madhava's chariot with one.

verses.text:
अथापरेण भल्लेन हेमपुङ्खेन पत्रिणा ।
धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे माधवस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Then with another feathered broad-headed arrow with golden shaft he cut the bow of the great-souled Madhava in the fight.

verses.text:
सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुस्त्यक्त्वा महारथः ।
गदां जग्राह महतीं भारद्वाजाय चाक्षिपत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki, enraged, threw down his bow, took up a great mace, and hurled it at Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा पट्टबद्धामयस्मयीम् ।
न्यवारयच्छरैर्द्रोणो बहुभिर्बहुरूपिभिः ॥

meaning.en: As that iron mace, bound with bands, came suddenly, Drona checked it with many arrows of many shapes.

verses.text:
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः ।
विव्याध बहुभिर्वीरं भारद्वाजं शिलाशितैः ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki, whose valor is true, took another bow and pierced the hero, Bharadvaja's son, with many stone-sharpened arrows.

verses.text:
स विद्ध्वा समरे द्रोणं सिंहनादममुञ्चत ।
तं वै न ममृषे द्रोणः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Having struck Drona in the battle, he gave a lion's roar, and Drona, best of all weapon-bearers, could not bear it.

verses.text:
ततः शक्तिं गृहीत्वा तु रुक्मदण्डामयस्मयीम् ।
तरसा प्रेषयामास माधवस्य रथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then, taking an iron spear with a golden shaft, he hurled it with force at the Madhava's chariot.

verses.text:
अनासाद्य तु शैनेयं सा शक्तिः कालसंनिभा ।
भित्त्वा रथं जगामोग्रा धरणीं दारुणस्वना ॥

meaning.en: That spear, like Death, missed Shaineya, tore through the chariot, and went into the earth with a terrible sound.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणं शिनेः पौत्रो राजन्विव्याध पत्रिणा ।
दक्षिणं भुजमासाद्य पीडयन्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then the grandson of Shini, O king, struck Drona with a feathered arrow, reaching his right arm and pressing him hard, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
द्रोणोऽपि समरे राजन्माधवस्य महद्धनुः ।
अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद रथशक्त्या च सारथिम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona too, O king, cut the Madhava's great bow in battle with a crescent-headed arrow, and struck his charioteer with a chariot-spear.

verses.text:
मुमोह सारथिस्तस्य रथशक्त्या समाहतः ।
स रथोपस्थमासाद्य मुहूर्तं संन्यषीदत ॥

meaning.en: Struck by the chariot-spear, his charioteer fainted, and, reaching the chariot seat, sat down a moment.

verses.text:
चकार सात्यकी राजंस्तत्र कर्मातिमानुषम् ।
अयोधयच्च यद्द्रोणं रश्मीञ्जग्राह च स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, O king, then did a superhuman deed: while fighting Drona, he himself took hold of the reins.

verses.text:
ततः शरशतेनैव युयुधानो महारथः ।
अविध्यद्ब्राह्मणं संख्ये हृष्टरूपो विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Then the great chariot-warrior Yuyudhana, delighted, struck the brahmin in the battle with a hundred arrows, lord of the people.

verses.text:
तस्य द्रोणः शरान्पञ्च प्रेषयामास भारत ।
ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा पपुः शोणितमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Drona sent five arrows at him, Bharata, and they pierced his armor and drank his blood in the fight.

verses.text:
निर्विद्धस्तु शरैर्घोरैरक्रुध्यत्सात्यकिर्भृशम् ।
सायकान्व्यसृजच्चापि वीरो रुक्मरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Deeply pierced by those terrible arrows, Satyaki grew very angry and the hero loosed arrows at Drona of the golden chariot.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणस्य यन्तारं निपात्यैकेषुणा भुवि ।
अश्वान्व्यद्रावयद्बाणैर्हतसूतान्महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Having struck Drona's charioteer to the earth with a single arrow, he drove the great-souled one's horses off with arrows, their charioteer dead.

verses.text:
स रथः प्रद्रुतः संख्ये मण्डलानि सहस्रशः ।
चकार राजतो राजन्भ्राजमान इवांशुमान् ॥

meaning.en: That chariot, rushing about in the fight, made thousands of circles, O king, shining like the sun, as it were, in the field.

verses.text:
अभिद्रवत गृह्णीत हयान्द्रोणस्य धावत ।
इति स्म चुक्रुशुः सर्वे राजपुत्राः सराजकाः ॥

meaning.en: "Charge, seize Drona's horses, run!" cried out all the princes with the kings.

verses.text:
ते सात्यकिमपास्याशु राजन्युधि महारथाः ।
यतो द्रोणस्ततः सर्वे सहसा समुपाद्रवन् ॥

meaning.en: Leaving Satyaki quickly in the fight, O king, those great chariot-warriors all suddenly ran to where Drona was.

verses.text:
तान्दृष्ट्वा प्रद्रुतान्सर्वान्सात्वतेन शरार्दितान् ।
प्रभग्नं पुनरेवासीत्तव सैन्यं समाकुलम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing all those fleeing, tormented by the Satvata's arrows, your army was again broken and confused.

verses.text:
व्यूहस्यैव पुनर्द्वारं गत्वा द्रोणो व्यवस्थितः ।
वातायमानैस्तैरश्वैर्हृतो वृष्णिशरार्दितैः ॥

meaning.en: Drona, having gone back to the gate of the formation, took his stand, carried by his horses, swift as wind, and pressed by the Vrishni's arrows.

verses.text:
पाण्डुपाञ्चालसंभग्नं व्यूहमालोक्य वीर्यवान् ।
शैनेये नाकरोद्यत्नं व्यूहस्यैवाभिरक्षणे ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the formation broken by the Pandavas and Panchalas, the mighty Drona made no effort against Shaineya but only to guard the formation.

verses.text:
निवार्य पाण्डुपाञ्चालान्द्रोणाग्निः प्रदहन्निव ।
तस्थौ क्रोधाग्निसंदीप्तः कालसूर्य इवोदितः ॥

meaning.en: Having checked the Pandavas and Panchalas, he stood blazing like fire, fed with the fire of his anger, like the sun of the world's end risen.
